buyingFaqs.question: How do I contact a seller?
buyingFaqs.answer: Open the listing and use the "Contact the Seller" card. You can reveal their phone number with one click, or view their profile to see their other listings and reviews.

buyingFaqs.question: How do I save a listing to look at later?
buyingFaqs.answer: Tap the heart icon on any listing card. If you're logged in, it's saved to your account's Watchlist so you can find it from any device. If you're not logged in, it's saved to this browser instead.

buyingFaqs.question: What does the "Featured" badge mean?
buyingFaqs.answer: Featured listings are cars an admin has chosen to highlight on the homepage for a limited time. It doesn't affect the listing's price or condition -- just its visibility.

buyingFaqs.question: Can I trust a seller's rating?
buyingFaqs.answer: Seller ratings are left by real buyers from their account, one review per buyer per seller, and sellers can't review themselves.

sellingFaqs.question: How do I list my car for sale?
sellingFaqs.answer: Go to Sell and enter your VIN -- we'll automatically look up your car's year, make, and model. Add photos, set a price, and publish.

sellingFaqs.question: How do I edit a listing or mark it as sold?
sellingFaqs.answer: Open your listing and click "Edit Listing." From there you can update details, reorder photos, or change its status to Pending or Sold.

sellingFaqs.question: Is my phone number visible to everyone?
sellingFaqs.answer: No. Only your area code shows by default -- the full number stays hidden until a buyer chooses to reveal it.

sellingFaqs.question: What's the difference between a private seller and a dealer?
sellingFaqs.answer: You can mark your account as a dealer/business from your profile. Dealer accounts show a "Dealer" badge on their listings and profile.

accountFaqs.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
accountFaqs.answer: Go to the login page and click "Forgot password?" -- we'll email you a reset link.

accountFaqs.question: Can I leave a review for a seller?
accountFaqs.answer: Yes, from their profile page. You'll need to be logged in, and you can't review your own profile.

accountFaqs.question: How do I update my profile or contact info?
accountFaqs.answer: Visit your profile page and click "Edit Profile" to update your business name, phone, location, description, and photo.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: OnlySalvage ("we", "us", or "our") operates the OnlySalvage marketplace, where private sellers and dealers list salvage and rebuilt vehicles for sale. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you create an account, we collect your username, email address, phone number (optional), and location (city, state, zip code) so buyers can find listings near them. When you list a vehicle, we collect the vehicle's details and any photos or documents (such as Carfax, alignment, or inspection reports) you choose to upload. We also automatically collect basic usage data, like pages visited and general device information, to help us maintain and improve the site.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to operate the marketplace: creating and displaying your public seller profile, connecting buyers and sellers, processing listings, calculating distance-based search results, and sending you account-related emails such as password resets. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: What Other Users Can See
sections.body: Your username, city and state, profile photo, business name (if you're a dealer), and any listings or reviews you've posted are visible to other users. Your phone number is only revealed to a buyer if they choose to reveal it, and your email address is private by default -- you can choose to make it visible on your public profile from your account settings.

sections.heading: Cookies & Local Storage
sections.body: We use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your session. If you're not logged in, your watchlist (liked listings) is stored in your browser's local storage instead of our servers. We don't use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable steps to protect your information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and secure password storage. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we can't guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your Choices
sections.body: You can update or correct your profile information at any time from your account settings. You can deactivate your account from your profile page, or contact us to request deletion of your data.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: OnlySalvage is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we'll update the date at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, contact us at support@onlysalvage.com.

TermsOfService.title: Terms of Service
TermsOfService.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of OnlySalvage. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account or list a vehicle on OnlySalvage.

sections.heading: Your Account
sections.body: You're responsible for keeping your password secure and for all activity under your account. Let us know right away if you believe your account has been compromised.

sections.heading: Listings
sections.body: When you list a vehicle, you agree that the information you provide -- including the VIN, title status (clean, rebuilt, or salvage), mileage, condition, and photos -- is accurate to the best of your knowledge. You're responsible for the content of your listings and must have the legal right to sell the vehicle.

sections.heading: OnlySalvage Is a Marketplace, Not a Party to the Sale
sections.body: OnlySalvage connects buyers and sellers -- we are not a party to any transaction between them, and we don't inspect, certify, or guarantee any vehicle listed on the site. Buyers are strongly encouraged to inspect a vehicle in person (or arrange a professional inspection) and review its title and history before completing a purchase.

sections.heading: Reviews
sections.body: Reviews must reflect a genuine transaction or interaction. Reviews that are fraudulent, abusive, or left to manipulate a seller's rating may be removed.

sections.heading: Prohibited Conduct
sections.body: You agree not to: list a vehicle you don't have the right to sell, misrepresent a vehicle's condition or title status, harass other users, or use the site for any unlawful purpose.

sections.heading: Fees
sections.body: Listing a vehicle on OnlySalvage is currently free. If we introduce paid features in the future, we'll clearly disclose any fees before you're charged.

sections.heading: Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability
sections.body: OnlySalvage is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. To the fullest extent permitted by law, OnlySalvage is not liable for any dispute, loss, or damage arising from a transaction between a buyer and a seller.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or that we believe pose a risk to other users.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of OnlySalvage after a change means you accept the updated Terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: Questions about these Terms? Contact us at support@onlysalvage.com.

AboutUs.title: About OnlySalvage
AboutUs.subtitle: The straightforward way to buy and sell salvage cars.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: Salvage and rebuilt vehicles are some of the best deals on the used car market, but finding them has traditionally meant sketchy auction sites, no seller accountability, and titles that get glossed over until it's too late. OnlySalvage was built to fix that -- a marketplace where every listing is tied to a real, rated seller account, and where the title status (salvage or rebuilt) is disclosed up front, not buried in the fine print.

sections.heading: What We Do
sections.body: We connect private sellers and dealers with buyers looking for a deal on a salvage or rebuilt vehicle. Sellers can list a car in minutes -- just enter a VIN and we'll pull in the year, make, and model automatically. Buyers can search by location, price, mileage, and title status, message sellers directly, and check a seller's rating before they buy.

sections.heading: Built on Trust
sections.body: Every account on OnlySalvage is real -- no anonymous listings. Buyers and sellers rate each other after a transaction, so a seller's reputation is earned, not claimed. We also provide 24/7 support if something goes wrong.

sections.heading: Get in Touch
sections.body: Have a question, feedback, or a partnership idea? We'd love to hear from you at support@onlysalvage.com.

Developers.gettingStartedStep3: Once approved, generate your token -- it's shown exactly once, so copy it somewhere safe.

Developers.authDescription: Every request (except the public reference endpoints) must include your token in the Authorization header:
Developers.authNote: Tokens are tied to your account -- every listing you create, edit, or read through the API is scoped to your own inventory only.
Developers.lifecycleDescription: A listing created through the API always starts as a draft, the same as starting one by hand on the site -- it can't publish without at least one photo, and this call can't carry one.
Developers.lifecycleStep1: POST a new listing -- it's created as a draft.
Developers.lifecycleStep2: Upload one or more photos to it.
Developers.lifecycleStep3: POST a status change (e.g. "AV") to publish it.

Developers.endpointModels: List models for a given make (no token required)
Developers.endpointList: List your own listings -- filterable, see below
Developers.endpointCreate: Create a new listing (always starts as a draft)
Developers.endpointRetrieve: Get a single listing of yours

Developers.endpointRenew: Bump an eligible listing back to the top
Developers.endpointImagesUpload: Upload a photo, by file or image_url
Developers.miscRateLimit: Requests are rate-limited to 120 per minute per account.
Developers.miscOwnership: Every endpoint is scoped to your own listings -- there's no way to read or modify another seller's inventory through this API.
Developers.miscErrors: Validation errors come back as a JSON object mapping field names to error messages, same as the rest of the site's API.
Developers.miscPagination: List responses are paginated (50 per page by default, up to 200 with ?page_size=); use the returned next/previous links to page through the rest.

Guide.title: Site Guide
Guide.subtitle: A few tips for features that aren't obvious right away.

tips.heading: Right-click a listing for quick actions
tips.body: Right-click any listing card to open it in a new tab, copy its link, add it to Compare or your Watchlist, contact the seller, or report it -- without opening the listing first.

tips.heading: Compare vehicles side by side
tips.body: Add a few listings to Compare (from the card menu or a listing page) and view them together to weigh price, mileage, and specs at a glance.

tips.heading: Your watchlist tracks availability
tips.body: Tap the heart icon on any listing card to save it -- logged in, it's kept in your account's Watchlist so you can find it from any device; logged out, it's saved to this browser instead. Either way, a car is automatically removed if it sells or is taken down, and reappears on its own if it becomes available again.

tips.heading: Sort by distance
tips.body: Enter your zip code (or allow location access) in the inventory filters to sort listings by how far away they are.

tips.heading: Recommendations improve as you browse
tips.body: The Recommended section on the home page and inventory page learns from what you search for and view -- the more you use it, the better it gets.

tips.heading: What "Featured" means
tips.body: Featured listings are cars an admin has chosen to highlight on the homepage for a limited time. It doesn't affect the listing's price or condition -- just its visibility.

tips.heading: Contact a seller directly
tips.body: Open the listing and use the "Contact the Seller" card to reveal their phone number with one click, or view their profile to see their other listings and reviews.

tips.heading: How to leave a review
tips.body: Ratings are left by real buyers from their own account -- one review per buyer per seller, and sellers can't review themselves, so what you see reflects real experience.
steps: Visit the seller's profile page.
Click "Leave a Review."
Choose a star rating and write a comment.
Submit -- you can only review a seller once.

tips.heading: Your own listings stand out while browsing
tips.body: Wherever you see one of your own listings mixed in with search results -- inventory, your profile, anywhere -- it's outlined with a highlighted border so you can spot it at a glance.

tips.heading: How to buy a car
tips.body: From your first search to picking up the keys -- here's the typical path from browsing to buying on OnlySalvage.
steps: Search inventory using filters for make, model, price, and location.
Compare your shortlist side by side to weigh price, mileage, and condition.
Schedule a test drive with the seller once you've narrowed it down.
Go through the Buyer's Checklist before you commit, so nothing gets missed.

tips.heading: Drafts save your progress
tips.body: Start a listing and leave whenever you want -- once you save it once, it's kept in your profile's Drafts tab so you can finish it later.

tips.heading: Editing or managing a listing you've already published
tips.body: Open your listing and click "Edit Listing" to update details, reorder photos, or change its status -- or right-click it from any card (your profile, inventory, anywhere) for the same actions as a shortcut: mark it Available, Pending, or Sold, publish/unpublish it, edit it, or delete it, all without opening the edit page.

tips.heading: Pause instead of delete
tips.body: Turn off "Published" on the edit page to hide a listing everywhere except your own profile (shown with an Inactive badge). Turn it back on anytime -- nothing is lost.

tips.heading: Renew to bump your listing back up
tips.body: Once a live listing is at least 7 days old, renew it from its Actions section to move it back to the top of search results -- up to 3 times.

tips.heading: Bulk Upload
tips.body: From Sell > Bulk Upload, dealers can add many vehicles at once from a spreadsheet. Each row becomes a draft to review and publish individually.
steps: Go to Sell > Bulk Upload.
Download the CSV template.
Fill in one row per vehicle and upload the file.
Review the imported drafts, add photos, and publish each one.

tips.heading: VIN auto-fill
tips.body: Enter a VIN when starting a listing and the year, make, model, and engine details fill in automatically.

tips.heading: Selling as a dealer
tips.body: Mark your account as a dealer/business from your profile settings. Dealer accounts show a "Dealer" badge on their listings and profile, and unlock CSV bulk upload.

tips.heading: Your phone number stays private
tips.body: Only your area code shows by default on a listing -- the full number stays hidden until a buyer chooses to reveal it.

tips.heading: How to sell a car, step by step
tips.body: The full flow from VIN to published listing, start to finish.
steps: Go to Sell and enter your VIN -- year, make, model, and engine fill in automatically.
Add clear photos of the car (exterior, interior, and any damage).
Set your price and add a description.
Publish it -- or save it as a draft to finish later.
Manage it anytime: mark it Pending or Sold, pause it, or renew it to stay at the top of search results.

tips.heading: Get verified
tips.body: Request seller verification from Settings to earn a verification badge that helps buyers trust your listings.

tips.heading: Manage your inventory with the API
tips.body: Verified sellers get instant API access from Settings > API Access -- generate a token and manage your listings programmatically. See the API docs for details.

tips.heading: Reset your password
tips.body: Go to the login page and click "Forgot password?" -- we'll email you a reset link.
steps: Go to the login page.
Click "Forgot password?"
Check your email for a reset link.
Set a new password and log in.

tips.heading: Update your profile
tips.body: Visit your profile page and click "Edit Profile" to update your business name, phone, location, description, and photo.

aboutRebuilt.title: Understanding Rebuilt & Salvage Titles
aboutRebuilt.paragraph1: A rebuilt or salvage title only means a vehicle was once declared a total loss -- it says nothing about the quality of the repair. A shop that does the job right can bring a wrecked car back to a genuinely safe, reliable condition, sometimes a better one than plenty of "clean" title vehicles on the road.
aboutRebuilt.paragraph2: A clean title isn't a guarantee either. If an owner pays for repairs out of pocket instead of filing an insurance claim, the accident is never reported, and the title stays "clean" no matter how severe the damage was. Title status alone can't tell you how a car was actually treated.
aboutRebuilt.paragraph3: That's why the steps in this checklist -- a vehicle history report, a VIN match, and a professional inspection -- matter more than the title status printed on the paperwork. They apply just as much to a "clean" title car as to a rebuilt one.
